objectives: This review sought to identify: (1) what interventions are used to promote advance care planning in adults with chronic kidney disease; (2) who initiates or delivers advance care planning interventions; (3) what is the rate of uptake of advance care planning among adults with chronic kidney disease; and (4) what are the outcomes of advance care planning interventions.
inclusion_criteria: Primary research of any design published from inception to September 2024; adults aged 18 years or older with chronic kidney disease, including those receiving hemodialysis and/or their caregivers, plus kidney healthcare professionals such as doctors and nurses; interventions designed for adults with chronic kidney disease and/or their caregivers, including interventions involving kidney healthcare professionals; for experimental studies, comparators were anticipated to be usual care (not relevant for qualitative studies); outcomes had to report intervention characteristics/types and/or intervention efficacy; studies including chronic kidney disease plus other chronic disease participants were eligible if data for chronic kidney disease participants could be extracted; English-language studies only.
exclusion_criteria: Reviews, protocols, non-research publications, grey literature, abstracts or conference proceedings, studies that were not fully accessible, and studies not published in English.
pmid_query: (("Chronic Kidney Failure"[MeSH Terms] OR "Renal Dialysis"[MeSH Terms] OR "Chronic Renal Insufficiency"[Title/Abstract] OR haemodialysis[Title/Abstract] OR "Kidney Replacement Therapy"[Title/Abstract] OR "end-stage kidney disease"[Title/Abstract] OR dialysis[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Advance Care Planning"[Title/Abstract] OR "Advance Directives"[Title/Abstract] OR "Durable Power of Attorney"[Title/Abstract] OR "Living Wills"[Title/Abstract] OR "Shared Decision Making"[Title/Abstract] OR ACP[Title/Abstract] OR "advance directive"[Title/Abstract] OR "living will"[Title/Abstract] OR "health care power of attorney"[Title/Abstract])) AND English[lang] AND ("0001/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/09/10"[Date - Publication])
selection_evidence: Results 3.1 states that 27 studies met the inclusion criteria. Results 3.2 states that Table 2 describes the interventions used across the 27 included studies and breaks them into 1 intervention-development study, 3 kidney-professional training studies, and 23 patient/caregiver/system interventions. The 27 author-year rows in Table 2 were cross-checked against the author-date reference list at the end of the manuscript. Figure 1 is the PRISMA flow diagram confirming the review-level inclusion count, and the manuscript also notes that Supporting Information Table 3 summarises study characteristics. Because the manuscript uses author-date citations rather than numbered references, exact ref_numbers are unavailable.
notes:
PMID fields are left empty because the local manuscript/supplemental files provide author-date citations and DOIs but not a complete set of PMIDs. The pmid_query is an inferred PubMed-style translation of the reported MeSH/keyword blocks because the full database-specific search strings were only cited as Supporting Information Table 2, which was not available as extracted text in the local files.

Manual update note: Manual review confirmed the remaining unresolved study is not indexed in PubMed; gold_pmids now reflect only OK rows.
